interface VmxStore {
    readonly hub: IMessageHub;
    readonly subscribe: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
    readonly getSnapshot: () => number;
    readonly getServerSnapshot: () => number;
    dispose(): void;
}
declare function createVmxStore(hub: IMessageHub): VmxStore;

declare function shallowEqual(current: unknown, next: unknown): boolean;

type Equality<T> = (current: T, next: T) => boolean;

declare function useVmx<T>(store: VmxStore, selector: () => T, equality?: Equality<T>): T;

interface HubBackedValue {
    readonly hub: IMessageHub;
}
declare function useVm<TVm extends object & HubBackedValue>(vm: TVm): TVm;

    readonly canExecute: boolean;

}

    readonly onError?: (error: unknown) => void;

    readonly hub: IMessageHub;
